## Highlights

This is the first Less3 release with installers. Each one is self-contained, so nothing else (not even .NET) needs to
be installed:

- **Windows, macOS, and Linux, on x64 and ARM64.** A setup `.exe`, a `.pkg` (and `.dmg`), `.deb`, `.rpm`, and
  AppImage files, plus portable archives for scripts and containers.
- **`less3` on your PATH.** Run it in any folder and that folder holds the server's configuration, database, and
  objects. The **Less3** menu entry does the same in `~/Less3`.
- **A systemd service on Linux.** The `.deb` and `.rpm` install a `less3` service that runs as its own account in
  `/var/lib/less3`, ready to enable once the server is configured.

The server itself is unchanged from 4.1.1 apart from one fix: with standard input redirected, as under a service
manager, it now runs headless instead of spinning in the interactive console.
